title: Permission requests a lent session's relay puts to the user
description: POST /api/permission-requests (Bearer = the ingest token) with `request`; the id makes a retry harmless. Answer: 200 `decision` when decided, else 202 `pending`. Then GET /api/permission-requests/<id>?wait=<seconds, at most 25>, repeated, answers the same way; unanswered for five minutes means deny. New fields may be added within v1.
